default.summary: Support reviews must identify customer risk, avoid sensitive-data requests, give clear next actions, and route urgent issues to a human escalation path.
required_actions: Acknowledge the customer's concern before asking for details.
Summarize the issue in one sentence.
Give a concrete next step and timeline when possible.
Escalate explicit escalation requests, regulatory threats, safety issues, and credential risks.
prohibited_actions: Do not ask for OTP, PIN, password, CVV, full card number, or full account number.
Do not dismiss explicit escalation requests.
Do not promise refund approval without checking the case status.
Do not close a call without a clear next action.
escalation_triggers: customer asks for manager, senior, legal, RBI, ombudsman, or formal complaint
customer is angry and issue remains unresolved
refund or payment dispute has no timeline

fintech_refund.summary: Fintech refund QA focuses on disputed debits, failed payments, reversal timelines, complaint handling, and sensitive financial data safety.
required_actions: Verify the transaction through approved non-sensitive identifiers.
Explain the refund or reversal status and expected timeline.
Create or reference a case ID when the customer needs follow-up.
Escalate regulatory language, repeated failed refunds, or explicit manager requests.
prohibited_actions: Do not request OTP, PIN, password, CVV, full card number, or netbanking credentials.
Do not blame the customer's bank without checking transaction status.
Do not mark the case resolved if money is still debited and no timeline is shared.
escalation_triggers: RBI, ombudsman, legal, fraud, chargeback, senior, manager

ecommerce_return.summary: Ecommerce return QA focuses on pickup status, replacement/refund timelines, return eligibility, and calm handling of repeated customer follow-ups.
required_actions: Confirm order or return status through approved identifiers.
State whether pickup, replacement, or refund is the next step.
Escalate when the customer reports repeated missed pickups or explicit complaint intent.
prohibited_actions: Do not request payment credentials or OTP.
Do not tell the customer only to wait when the SLA has passed.
Do not reject return concerns without explaining the policy reason.
escalation_triggers: customer asks for complaint or manager

telecom_billing.summary: Telecom billing QA focuses on overcharge disputes, recharge failures, service impact, plan clarity, and complaint escalation.
required_actions: Confirm billing period, plan, or recharge status through approved identifiers.
Explain the charge, adjustment, or refund path clearly.
Share the ticket or complaint timeline when billing impact continues.
Escalate repeat billing disputes, service outages, or formal complaint requests.
prohibited_actions: Do not request OTP, PIN, password, or payment credentials.
Do not ignore service outage impact when billing is disputed.
Do not close with generic plan information if the customer reported an incorrect charge.
escalation_triggers: customer asks for senior, complaint, or legal route
